title: Drama Education as a Medium for Learning I
description: An overview of the theory and practice of drama in education based on the current curriculum in elementary and middle school. Through a workshop format, students explore the principles and methods of instruction for initial classroom implementation.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of EDCI 305A, EDCI 305, EDCI 313, DE 204, DE 304, EDUC 305.
May be offered in English or French.

prerequisites.text: Admission to a program in Teacher Education.
